national_news.title: HM Amit Shah Launches ₹5,610 Crore Development Initiatives in Arunachal Pradesh
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah launched four major development initiatives worth over ₹5,610 crore in Arunachal Pradesh, focusing on border infrastructure and youth employment.
Key programmes launched include Mission Shikshit Arunachal – Phase II, CM’s State Power Development Programme, CM’s State Rural Road Development Programme, and Mission SURAKSHA.
Under the Vibrant Villages Programme (VVP), 199 projects across 11 border districts along the China border were initiated alongside Mobile Medical Units with AI-based TB screening.

national_news.title: Three Indian Films Among Ten Nominated for ICFT-UNESCO Gandhi Medal at IFFI
bullets: Ten films have been selected to compete for the ICFT-UNESCO Gandhi Medal at the International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa, acknowledging works reflecting non-violence, peace, and tolerance.
India is represented by three entries: Sarfaraz Alam's 'Kabir Sir ka Akhri Lesson', Kannan S.'s 'Scroll', and Muskan Asthana's 'Sev Micchar'.
The adjudication jury is headed by Algerian filmmaker and critic Professor Ahmed Bedjaoui.

national_news.title: CCEA Approves Investment for 1,200 MW Kalai-II Hydroelectric Project in Arunachal Pradesh
bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved an investment of Rs 14,105.83 crore for the 1,200 MW Kalai-II Hydroelectric Project on the Lohit River in Anjaw district, Arunachal Pradesh.

The run-of-the-river project will be executed via a joint venture between THDC India Limited (a subsidiary of NTPC Limited) and the Government of Arunachal Pradesh, designed to generate 4,852.95 MU of electricity annually.

Located near Namdapha Tiger Reserve and Kamlang Wildlife Sanctuary, the project area forms a critical habitat for the critically endangered White-bellied Heron (listed under Schedule I of the Wildlife Protection Act) and the Takin.
